historical_table49_trace.method: Compare each frozen alert under the original Table 4.9 row2 T1190 and row3 predicted-Web policies; only originally unsupported dispositions are reclassified in that historical table.

latency: No new operational latency or H3 result claimed. Replay omits full-alert SMT timing; original stored SMT agrees exactly, and modified scan SMT is independently tested at four boundary fixtures.

policy_scope.all_web: Separate broader predicted-Web coverage sensitivity, not the selected narrow correction.
policy_scope.combined: Narrow Web-Brute coverage correction plus scan branch retirement.
policy_scope.missingness: Fixed frozen candidate hypothesis; compare zero-normalized facts to frozen condition-specific training medians and rule-specific three-valued logic. Decisive true/false branches resolve even when another fact is unknown.
policy_scope.scan: Remove impossible SYN>2 AND total_packets<300 alternative; preserve score>=.80 AND packets/s>1000 exactly. No new threshold.
policy_scope.web_brute: Predicted label starts Web Attack and contains brute; flow features cannot establish web login attempts, therefore T1110 mapped but out of rule coverage and retained inconclusive.

raw_sample.source_note: Original standardize_columns converts nonfinite values to NaN before sampling; audit preserves that sampled raw/nonfinite-as-missing frame.
